_comment: Candidate chat models for scripts/eval_models.py. Tags and sizes were read from the Ollama library pages on 2026-11-01; licences are listed per entry. The statements about language support and quality come from model cards and general reports as I know them; no published per-model Hungarian benchmark (HuLU, OpenHuEval, HuGME) could be reached, so treat them as unverified. Nothing here was run: whether a model teaches well in Hungarian, and whether it fits, is exactly what the run decides.

expected_fit is an estimate from the file size plus an 8192-token context, per GPU; the run measures the real placement. Partial or multi-GPU placement is slower and depends on the link between the GPUs and on host RAM, which the run shows.
Copy this file outside the repo (or to a gitignored path) to change it.

candidates.expected_fit: single GPU of 8 GB or more; room for the context
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 (7B size; the 3B and 72B sizes use other terms)
candidates.reason: Reference point. Broad multilingual instruct model with 32K context; Hungarian is not among the languages Qwen2.5 lists as supported, so its Hungarian is the question.

candidates.expected_fit: single GPU of 8 GB or more
candidates.reason: Qwen3 claims support for about 119 languages including Hungarian, a step up from Qwen2.5 on paper. It reasons in <think> blocks by default; the script strips them and sends think=false, which the Ollama version pinned in the compose file (0.6.6) may ignore, in which case the thinking tokens cost time. Needs Ollama 0.6.6 or newer.

candidates.expected_fit: single GPU of 8 GB or more, with long context to spare
candidates.license: Gemma Terms of Use (use restrictions apply; not an OSI open-source licence)
candidates.reason: Gemma 3 is trained on 140+ languages and is generally reported to be strong in smaller European languages for its size; the quantisation-aware tag keeps quality close to full precision. Needs Ollama 0.6.0 or newer.

candidates.role: likely best quality that is still local
candidates.expected_fit: does not fit one 8 GB GPU with context; needs a layer split across GPUs or partial CPU offload
candidates.license: Gemma Terms of Use (use restrictions apply; not an OSI open-source licence)
candidates.reason: The largest Gemma 3 that is realistic here. If it is clearly better in Hungarian than the 4B, the run shows what the split costs in time to first token and tokens per second. gemma3:12b-it-q4_K_M (8.2 GB) is the slightly smaller alternative.

candidates.expected_fit: weights alone nearly fill an 8 GB GPU; expect a split or partial CPU offload with the context
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 (from the model card; not shown on the Ollama page)
candidates.reason: Multilingual 12B from Mistral and NVIDIA with a large context window; Hungarian is not among its headline languages, so it is a test of a non-Qwen, non-Gemma family. q3_K_M (6.1 GB) would fit one GPU at some quality cost.

candidates.expected_fit: 12B-class: does not fit one 8 GB GPU with context; needs a split or partial offload
candidates.license: The page says Apache-2.0, but it is a fine-tune of Gemma 3, whose terms normally pass on to derivatives: treat it as Gemma Terms of Use until clarified
candidates.reason: The only Hungarian-tuned chat model found on Ollama that is usable here: a Gemma 3 fine-tune on Hungarian text, 128K context listed. It is a one-person upload with no published evaluation, so the run has to show whether it beats plain gemma3:12b. It ships its own default system prompt in Hungarian; the script sends the teacher prompt as the whole prompt.

not_selected.mp3pintyo/sambalingo-hungarian-chat: Hungarian chat model (Llama 2 based) but only a 4K context, too short for retrieval prompts.
not_selected.sony/puli-lliumix-32k: NYTK's Hungarian PULI LlumiX is a 13 GB base model, not an instruction/chat model.
not_selected.csabeszkukesz/qwen-hun-27b: Described as a Hungarian model (16 GB); unknown provenance and too large for one 8 GB GPU.
not_selected.aya-expanse:8b: Hungarian is not among its 23 languages, and the licence is non-commercial.
not_selected.llama3.1:8b: Hungarian is not an officially supported language.
